% Compilation-only specimen; never included in a manuscript upload.
\documentclass{article}
\input{paper/setup/profile}
\input{paper/setup/packages}
\input{paper/setup/optional-packages}

% The section-counter alias follows arXiv's documented TeX Live 2025 workaround.
% Shared counters need an explicit environment-specific type as well.
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\AddToHook{env/theorem/begin}{\crefalias{section}{theorem}}
\AddToHook{env/lemma/begin}{\crefalias{section}{lemma}\crefalias{theorem}{lemma}}

\begin{document}
\section{Reference types}
\label{sec:specimen}
\begin{equation}
  1 + 1 = 2
  \label{eq:specimen}
\end{equation}
\begin{figure}[ht]
  \centering\rule{1cm}{1cm}
  \caption{A compilation-test figure.}
  \label{fig:specimen}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[ht]
  \centering
  \caption{A compilation-test table.}
  \label{tab:specimen}
  \begin{tabular}{cc}
    \toprule
    Input & Output \\
    \midrule
    1 & 2 \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
\end{table}
\begin{theorem}
  \label{thm:specimen}
  A compilation-test theorem.
\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}
  \label{lem:specimen}
  A compilation-test lemma with a shared counter.
\end{lemma}
\begin{theorem}
  \label{thm:after-lemma}
  The shared-counter alias does not leak to the next theorem.
\end{theorem}
See \cref{sec:specimen}, \cref{eq:specimen}, \cref{fig:specimen}, \cref{tab:specimen}, \cref{thm:specimen}, \cref{lem:specimen}, and \cref{thm:after-lemma}.
